findings.what: Fixed bars (the app-install banner, the header) were 433px wide on a 375px phone.
findings.why: The compiled pages carried a generic viewport meta; without the product's maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=0 a phone widens its layout viewport to the product's horizontal overflow. A full-page screenshot hid it.
findings.status: fixed — scripts/compile.mjs copies the product's own viewport meta

findings.what: The app-install banner lost its text column; the phone dashboard was 0.35% off.
findings.why: A link inside a link: legal in the DOM React builds, impossible in parsed HTML — the parser closed the outer link.
findings.status: fixed — such elements are written <pf-el> and restored on load (scripts/lib/nested-a.mjs); the phone dashboard is now 0.003%

findings.what: Agent Performance was 0.5–0.9% off on every state; each badge description sat 5px high.
findings.why:

inside a

: the parser closed the

and left an empty

with margins after it.
findings.status:
fixed — the same rule set covers blocks in

, links in links, buttons in buttons, forms in forms, headings in headings

findings.what: A quality popover on Reports · Listing Report was missing from its compiled state.
findings.why: It was frozen mid-entrance, still carrying antd's zoom-appear classes; the copy has no keyframes to finish the animation, so it stayed at opacity 0.
findings.status: fixed — compile freezes only a settled page, and entering motion classes are dropped

findings.what: Dropdowns, select lists and pickers opened on the other side of their field in the reference shot.
findings.why: A full-page shot resizes the viewport and antd re-places open overlays; the frozen copy kept the first placement.
findings.status: fixed — any open overlay, or any scrolled box, is shot at the viewport

findings.what: A clicked or hovered control showed its hover colour in the product and not in the copy.
findings.why: A static page has no pointer.
findings.status: fixed — freeze.js marks what is hovered, focused or pressed, and the compiled CSS matches the mark as well as the pseudo-class

findings.what: Half the phone component cut-outs failed; 31 reference shots were blank.
findings.why: Mobile emulation lays fixed and overflowing content out against a widened layout viewport, and element shots outside the visual viewport come out empty; shooting an off-canvas element scrolled clipped containers and moved every later shot.
findings.status: fixed — responsive components are collected in a plain 375 window (what a component page's frame is), off-canvas and clipped-away elements are skipped, and scroll offsets are put back

findings.what: Inline components and centred text were a fraction of a pixel off.
findings.why: clientWidth is rounded (72 for 72.39), and an inline box takes no vertical margin.
findings.status: fixed — widths come from the rect, and an inline cut-out is placed by the box around it

findings.what: One failed state could spoil every state after it (the congratulations modal kept reopening; a navigation in flight interrupted the next page load).
findings.why: A harness flag set by a state that timed out stayed set.
findings.status: fixed — flags are spent by the load they were set for, and a failed state leaves the page

findings.what: The explorer found 17 dashboard states where it had found 24.
findings.why: Richer fixture data put more controls before the 60-candidate cap.
findings.status: fixed — breadth first (one control of every kind before any repeat), up to 120; 157 web and 119 responsive states found

findings.what: The web and the responsive layout shared one stylesheet whose single cascade order suited neither.
findings.why: The same rules come in different orders on a phone’s pages (80,553 disagreements merged together).
findings.status: fixed — one stylesheet per layout: profolio.css for the web, profolio.mobile.css for the responsive layout

findings.what: 29 of 532 files — dashboard popovers and drawers over the recent-listings table, and three responsive inline states — do not render the same on their layout’s shared stylesheet.
findings.why: Opening those overlays injects the product’s styles in an order that contradicts the table’s rules in the shared order: the table’s columns move.
findings.status: open — each keeps its own CSS inline and stays within the pixel bar; split per layout, the same 29 remain

findings.what: 26 reference shots were blank — controls deep inside drawers (filters, details, leaderboard).
findings.why: The reference un-clipped every ancestor, which threw away the drawer body's scroll and left the control below a fixed box's edge, where no scroll reaches.
findings.status: fixed — the control is scrolled into view inside its own boxes, and only boxes it does not fit in are un-clipped

findings.what: The same control opened a modal on the web and a drawer on a phone, and read as two unrelated states.
findings.why: The product swaps the component by device; the explorer names each after what it is.
findings.status: fixed — paired by trigger into one state with both files

findings.what: SKILL.md said the product never writes "SAR" beside a price.
findings.why: It does once, in copy: "Get one through Bayut, starting from SAR 250." (ad-license-form.js:106).
findings.status: fixed — the rule now names that sentence as the one exception

findings.what: The package plan icons (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Starter…) paint with each other’s gradients on /packages.
findings.why: Every one of them uses the same SVG ids — a, b, c, d, e (src/components/svg.js, an optimiser’s output) — and url(#b) resolves to the first id="b" on the page.
findings.status: reported — the pages show what the product paints; each icon’s component page shows it with its own gradient, and says it differs from the product

findings.what: A card with a sticky header came out 44px lower in its example.
findings.why: In a short example frame the sticky header sticks; in its page it sat in the flow.
findings.status: fixed — a cut-out keeps sticky boxes where they were

findings.what: At 375 the product is wider than the phone (about 433px).
findings.why: The product's own layout; reproduced faithfully.
findings.status: reported — listed below for a redesign

findings.what: /user-settings/preferences crashes for any account without a photo; the member-area listings do not mount in the harness.
findings.why: A product bug at common/transformers/user.js:35; the member area loads the classified site's header from another origin.
findings.status: known gaps — not compiled

findings.what: ad-license with the city select open was 2.8% off: the form panel showed its content 42px higher than the product.
findings.why: The copy put the panel back at its scroll before the web fonts arrived; they reflowed the text above it, and the browser’s scroll anchoring moved the panel to keep what it showed.
findings.status: fixed — scroll offsets are put back again once the fonts are in; the state is now within the bar
